EVAL-F-03-S71.title: Define EvaluateCare Facade Input and Output Contracts
EVAL-F-03-S71.description: Define and enforce request/response schemas for EvaluateCare facade methods, aligning with existing Pydantic tool models for clinical trials and provider detail flows to ensure consistent validation and structured outputs.

EVAL-F-03-S72.title: Expose EvaluateCare Facade via FastAPI Entry Point
EVAL-F-03-S72.description: Integrate EvaluateCare facade into the FastAPI application layer (main.py) to ensure it is properly wired, callable through the application runtime, and aligned with existing service initialization patterns.

EVAL-F-03-S73.title: Implement Error Handling and Response Normalization in Facade
EVAL-F-03-S73.description: Add standardized error handling, fallback behavior, and response normalization within the EvaluateCare facade to handle partial failures from clinical trials and provider detail services while maintaining a consistent response structure.
